add-constraint: Both feature gate CHECKs are added only when absent, to the source table created by the previous migration, which no application code writes before this release; acquisition is bounded by 2s lock_timeout.
create-policy: The feature gate policies are catalog-only additions to the new source table, under 2s lock_timeout.
create-trigger: The gate write and repair triggers on the new source table are catalog-only creations that read no rows; SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE is held only for the statement, under 2s lock_timeout.
